queries:
WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
)
SELECT Name, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_type) AS difference
FROM per_type
WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_type);
WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
)
SELECT Name, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_type) AS difference
FROM per_type
WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_type);
WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS Name,
         CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS value
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
avg_all AS (
  SELECT AVG(value) AS mean_value FROM per_type
)
SELECT p.Name, p.value, p.value - a.mean_value AS difference
FROM per_type p, avg_all a
WHERE p.value > a.mean_value;

  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804

)
SELECT Name, avg_val, avg_val - (SELECT AVG(avg_val) FROM per_type) AS difference
FROM per_type
WHERE avg_val > (SELECT AVG(avg_val) FROM per_type);
WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT m.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes < 10323804
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per_type
)
SELECT p.Name, p.avg_ratio, p.avg_ratio - o.mean_ratio AS difference
FROM per_type p, overall o
WHERE p.avg_ratio > o.mean_ratio;
WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes <= 10323804
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall AS (

)
SELECT p.Name, p.avg_ratio, p.avg_ratio - o.mean_ratio AS difference
FROM per_type p, overall o
WHERE p.avg_ratio > o.mean_ratio;
